chunks: Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام.
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
which was taken upon them concerning our wilayah.

key_terms.أَخَذَ: was taken or imposed as a covenant
key_terms.عَلَيْهِمْ: upon them, as an obligation or commitment
key_terms.وَلَايَتِنَا: our wilayah, meaning the divinely ordained authority and loyalty of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.يُوفُونَ: they faithfully fulfill and carry out

ai.seo_question: How do Shia hadith interpret the verse “They fulfill vows” in relation to wilayah?
ai.summary: This narration explains the phrase “They fulfill vows” as referring to a covenant taken upon the people concerning the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It presents the verse as an affirmation of loyalty to their divinely appointed authority.
